description: Python coding project (COMP1101 Inventory Manager CLI) supplied as a ZIP with a numbered specification and a weighted rubric (Functionality 40%, Code quality 20%, Testing 20%, Documentation 20%; each criterion out of 100 with Excellent/Good/Satisfactory/Weak/Fail bands; final mark = weighted percentage). Tests RUBRIC mode with authorised numerical marking out of 100, activation of the CODE specialist review only, static-only code review disclosure, and that no essay-style findings are produced. Deliberate defects: (1) average_price() in inventory/core.py divides by len(items) with no guard, so an empty inventory raises ZeroDivisionError; (2) remove_item() raises KeyError for an unknown name and cli.prompt_remove() does not catch it, so invalid input crashes the program; (3) tests/test_core.py covers only two functions (add_item, list_items) instead of at least three; (4) README.md explains how to run the program but not how to run the tests.
report_must_contain: CODE WAS REVIEWED STATICALLY; EXECUTION WAS NOT VERIFIED.
